turns.text: The date-range test fails every month end. Can you find out why?

The test builds "one month ago" with setMonth, which overflows on the 31st (March 31 minus a month becomes March 3). I changed the helper to clamp to the last day of the month and pinned the clock in the test.
Great, commit that. Then let's plan the CSV export for the report page: I want a button, ISO dates, and two decimals for amounts.
Committed the date fix. For the export, I'd add an endpoint reusing the report query plus a button on the page; I've sketched it in a scratch file but not committed anything.
